source.excerpt: Shared as an SEO and AEO teammate that works with the stack you already have.

body:
## What it does

Reads what you have already connected, recommends the stack you are missing rather than demanding it up front, and turns the gaps into content briefs a writer can act on. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @adamta shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
